title: Decoupage, fenti ya ƙare kuma maimaita tsarin da ya wuce
course_title: Babban Kayan Ado na Gida & Haɓakawa

say: Decoupage, fenti ya ƙare, da maimaita tsarin da ya wuce.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don ƙirar gida biyu na Babban Kayan Gida da Upcycling.
Tire na fili, tulu, stool ko matashi na iya canzawa ta samansa. Advanced decoupage yana da gefuna waɗanda ke ɓacewa, babu kumfa, da fili mai santsi don gogewa.

say: Launi mai launi yana ba da fenti da ruwa don haka ƙwayar itace ta nuna. Sponging yana da launi na biyu, yana juya soso don guje wa maimaita alama.

say: Fentin alli da aka shirya yana da tsada. Girke-girke na gida yana amfani da filastar kashi 1 na Paris, ɓangaren ruwa mai sanyi 1, da fentin emulsion sassa 3, ta ƙara.

items: Girke-girke: 1 plaster, 1 ruwa, 3 emulsion
Shirye-shiryen 800 ml: 800/5 = 160 ml kowane sashi
160 ml plaster + 160 ml ruwa, santsi
Mix cikin 480 ml emulsion; motsa tsakanin riguna

say: Misali, Grace a Jos na bukatar kimanin 750 ml na kwasfa biyu. Don zama lafiya ta shirya 800 ml. Wato sassa 5, don haka 160 ml kowace sashi.

say: Manne PVA da yawancin varnishes ba a gwada su azaman amintaccen abinci. Yi ado kawai bayan faranti masu haske ko kuma wajen tuluna, kuma a buga abubuwa: goge mai tsabta, kar a jiƙa, amfani da kayan ado.

panel.heading: Dokokin aminci guda uku don saman

cards.d: Decoupage ba shi da aminci ga abinci kuma yana laushi idan an jika shi. Kada ku taɓa sayar da faranti, kwano ko kofuna don cin abinci.
Mix da yashi a waje ko ta taga buɗaɗɗe, sanya abin rufe fuska na ƙura, nisantar da yara. Kada a taɓa zuba filastar ƙasa a nutse.
Yanke daga jikinka da sauran hannunka, yi amfani da mai mulki na karfe, hular wuka, kunsa ruwan wukake a cikin tef.

say: Filasta da fenti mai yashi suna yin ƙura mai kyau. Yi aiki a waje ko ta taga a buɗe, sanya abin rufe fuska na kura, kuma a nisanta yara. Kada a taɓa zuba ragowar filastar ƙasa a nutse.

say: Don tunawa. Takarda siririya da riguna masu bakin ciki da yawa suna rufe gefuna. Faux ya gama Layer kala biyu. Mix fentin alli daya, daya, uku. Fit yana maimaitawa ta hanyar daidaita giɓin. Gwada kowane gamawa akan samfurin farko.

say: Yanzu yi allon samfurin decoupage da yanki guda ɗaya da aka gama tare da alamar kulawa, ɗakin karatu na ƙarshe na samfurori biyar, da maimaita samfurin tare da rubutaccen lissafin ku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
